title: The review form, filled in from the request
description: The named fields are the input contract of product-selection-review. A field is present only when the request stated it.

category.description: The category given in the input, unchanged. Only decided here when the input did not carry one.

problem.title: The problem it solves, in the requester's words

reasoning.title: The case made for this tool over anything else

alternativesConsidered.title: What else was looked at and why it was set aside

cost.title: Price, seats, term, and who pays

dataHandled.description: `unknown` is the honest answer whenever the request does not say, and it is the only answer this persona may reach without the request saying it.

usersAffected.title: People who would use it, only when a number was given

missing.title: Fields the request never answered
missing.description: The reason a request goes back, named field by field. A field is listed here or filled in above, never both.

quoted.title: Where each filled field came from
quoted.description: The span of the request that the value was taken from, so a reader can check the form against the request without reading both in full.

text.title: Words from the request, copied exactly

reviewable.description: True only when tool, problem and reasoning are all filled in. product-selection-review requires those three, so a false here means there is nothing to review yet.

summary.title: One or two sentences for whoever reads the queue
summary.description: What was asked for and what the request does not say. Not an opinion on the request.
